name: DaVinci Resolve AI
summary: Pro editing, color and audio software with built-in AI tools.
description: Blackmagic Design's DaVinci Resolve combines editing, color grading, effects and audio mixing. Its Neural Engine adds automatic masking, smart reframing, voice isolation and transcript-based editing. A very complete free version exists.
